refuted.fact: sourcing_notes: 「fsc.gov.tw 的站內搜尋外包給 Google CSE，無法當一手管道用，新聞稿列表頁只回最近十幾則且分頁靠 JS，因此改用行政院公報資訊網的全文查詢做遍歷」
refuted.why: The FSC news list has a working server-side keyword and date-range search that needs no JavaScript. A plain form POST to https://www.fsc.gov.tw/ch/home.jsp with id=96, parentpath=0, mcustomize=news_list.jsp, dtable=News, aplistdn=ou=news,ou=multisite,ou=chinese,ou=ap_root,o=fsc,c=tw, keyword=虛擬資產服務法, page=1, pagesize=100 returned HTTP 200 (129,023 bytes) and a server-rendered result table with exactly three rows: 2026-06-30 立法院院會三讀通過「虛擬資產服務法」 (dataserno=202606300002), 2025-03-25 金管會預告「虛擬資產服務法」草案 (dataserno=202503250002), 2025-02-13 金管會召開「研商虛擬資產服務法草案座談會」 (dataserno=202502130003). It also accepts qptdate/qdldate bounds. It is a title search rather than full text, which is a real limit, but it is first-party and usable. Because this route was written off, two directly relevant FSC press releases were never read (see additional_findings).

unsupported.fact: F69: 「意見陳述期間為刊登公報翌日起 30 日內（一般為 60 日）」
unsupported.why: The 30-day period and the stated reason for shortening it ('為配合行政院打擊詐欺犯罪之重大治安政策推動，爰縮短法規預告期間') are verbatim in the 2026-08-13 公告 and I confirmed them. The parenthetical '（一般為 60 日）' appears in no source cited; it is the researcher's own generalisation. Strike it, or replace it with a sourced comparison: the FSC's own 2025-03-25 VASP Act draft notice used 60 days ('請於公告翌日起60日內') and the 經濟部 2026-07-24 notice used 60 days — both first-party and quotable. A general rule is not.

unsupported.fact: F11: 「該頁只呈現預告期間尚未截止的案件。」
unsupported.why: Not stated anywhere on law.fsc.gov.tw/DraftForum.aspx. The page carries tabs 最新法規草案 / 歷史法規草案 and a 預告終止日 per row (115.10.02, 115.10.19, 115.11.06 — all still future on the check date), which is consistent with the inference but does not assert it. The three-draft listing itself is confirmed. Record the inference as an observation, not as what the page says.

unsupported.fact: F68: 「這是目前可查到、第一份在虛擬資產服務法尚未施行時就援引其定義條文的其他機關命令。」
unsupported.why: The order itself (財政部 115年9月3日 台財稅字第11504611390號令, 行政院公報 032卷164期) is confirmed verbatim in the PDF I fetched. The '第一份' claim rests on a negative result from one corpus only, the 行政院公報 full-text search. Orders and 函釋 not published in the gazette (e.g. items appearing only on 稅務入口網 or 財政部法令查詢系統) would never show there, so 'first' is not established. Drop '第一份', or state it precisely as '行政院公報全文查詢「虛擬資產服務法」在查核日只有 3 筆，其中唯一的其他機關命令是這一份'.

additional_findings: MISSED FIRST-PARTY SOURCE, materially changes what the article can say: 金管會新聞稿「金管會預告『虛擬資產服務法』草案」, 2025-03-25, https://www.fsc.gov.tw/ch/home.jsp?id=96&parentpath=0&mcustomize=news_view.jsp&dataserno=202503250002&dtable=News (HTTP 200, 112,368 bytes, 更新日期 2025-03-25). The pre-announced draft had only 50 articles — its point nine reads 「九、本法施行後之過渡安排及本法之施行日期。（草案第49條及第50條）」 — against 56 as enacted, and 穩定幣 occupied 草案第34條及第35條 only, against 第34條至第41條 (Chapter 4) in the law. It also gives the comment period ('請於公告翌日起60日內'), the drafting basis ('金管會前於113年1月委外研究訂定虛擬資產管理專法，經參考歐盟、日本、韓國、香港、英國及國際證券管理機構組織（IOSCO）等外國規範'), and the plan '預計於114年6月底前依行政程序將本法草案陳報行政院審查'. A fully first-party draft-versus-law contrast the record currently lacks.

MISSED FIRST-PARTY SOURCE: 金管會新聞稿「金管會召開『研商虛擬資產服務法草案座談會』」, 2025-02-13, dataserno=202502130003 (HTTP 200, 110,421 bytes). FSC convened 專家學者、VASP同業公會及中央銀行 on 2025-02-13 and said it would pre-announce in 114年3月 and report the draft to 行政院 by end of 114年6月. Completes a timeline the research record only starts at 2026-04-02.

MISSED FIRST-PARTY SOURCE, peripheral but it fills a gap the researcher flagged: 金管會新聞稿 2026-08-04, dataserno=202608040002 (HTTP 200, 114,235 bytes). It carries the staged Travel Rule schedule the 2026-08-13 gazette draft does not: '第一階段先行適用於境內 VASP 間之移轉（預計115年10月施行），第二階段再擴及至境內與境外 VASP 間之移轉（預計116年年底施行）'. It also confirms '金管會於114年9月22日公布完成洗錢防制登記之虛擬資產服務商（VASP）名單' (matching the 114年9月22日 dates in the list PDF) and that the Art 7 mechanism '迄今尚未施行'. WRITER CAUTION: this is the 洗錢防制法 sub-rule, not a 虛擬資產服務法 sub-law, and 115年10月 must never be presented as the Act's commencement date.

MATERIAL ARTICLES NOT RECORDED AT ALL, both readable at law.fsc.gov.tw/LawContent.aspx?id=GL004301: 第24條 — 虛擬資產交換商 must ensure the asset has a 符合主管機關規定之發行說明文書 before providing service and must 公告 it, with exceptions for 無償 issuance and assets issued as '維持其分散式帳本運作或驗證其交易之勞務報酬'; and 第28條 — the same white-paper duty plus 審查基準及審查程序 for 虛擬資產承銷商. The research covers 第25/26/27條 but skips these two, and a white-paper requirement is among the most reader-facing rules in the Act.

NOT RECORDED: 第21條 — 主管機關 may cap 出借總額, per-asset 出借限額 and lending to 關係人或關係企業 for 出借虛擬資產業務, by 辦法. This matters because the editorial_brief wants to highlight 借貸商 as one of the two categories the AML registration regime never had; without 第21條 there is nothing on how that lending is actually constrained.

NOT RECORDED: the rest of 第47條 beyond 第1項 — 第2項 自首 plus full settlement with victims within six months can 減輕或免除其刑; 第3項 the 自白 route; 第4項 fines may be raised into the range of illicit gains where those exceed the statutory maximum; 第5項 confiscation. Also 第54條 (易服勞役 up to two years for fines reaching NT$50m, up to three years for NT$100m). The record currently has only the headline 3–10 years / NT$10m–200m figure.

NOT RECORDED: 第46條第3項至第5項 — where a VASP's business or finances deteriorate badly, 主管機關 may bar asset transfers by the firm and its 負責人/職員, or order the business transferred to another VASP, may require it to find a successor VASP, and may 指定 one if it cannot. The not_said entry correctly says the Act does not spell out whether this applies to an Art 55 lapse, but the substance speaks directly to the 'what happens to my platform' question the brief wants answered.

NOT RECORDED, minor: 第5條 (international cooperation and information exchange with foreign regulators — relevant to the 境外平台 framing), 第13條 (the leverage caps exist even though no figure is set; not_said mentions only the missing figure), 第7條第2項 (分支機構及自動化服務設備 need permission or approval), 第16條/第17條 (誠信及善良管理人注意義務; 保密義務), 第30條第2項 (同業公會 may levy fees beyond 商業團體法 with FSC 備查), 第43條第1項至第3項 (inspection powers including 封存或調取文件 and FSC-appointed 律師/會計師 inspections at the inspected party's expense).

CHECKS YOU ASKED FOR THAT CAME BACK CLEAN: (a) no fact is sourced to a news outlet, aggregator, law-firm blog or search snippet — all four sources[] and all nine supporting URLs are 金管會 / 證期局 / 法務部全國法規資料庫 / 行政院公報, inside the crypto.md whitelist, and the media and PwC items are correctly confined to unverified_or_excluded; (b) no identifier looks guessed — pcode G0400163 re-derived from the site's own search, GL004301 supplied by crypto.md, GL004000 hyperlinked from the sfb page, and every 發文字號 (華總一經字第11500067161號, 台財稅字第11504611390號, 金管證券字第1150383750號, 經授商字第11500728390號, 金管證券字第1130386024號) verbatim in a document I fetched; (c) no date conflation — 三讀 2026-06-30, 公布 2026-07-22, 施行日 未定, 行政院會 2026-04-02 vs 公報出刊 2026-04-10, and 完成登記日 114年9月22日 / 115年9月3日 vs 名單更新日 2026-09-03 are all kept apart; (d) the four 金管會 self-assessment sentences are correctly flagged is_vendor_claim=true, and the one place the press release is looser than the statute (穩定幣: 新聞稿 '須取得中央銀行同意及金管會許可' vs 第34條 'FSC permits, after 會商中央銀行同意') is caught and called out rather than copied.

The single miss, F04, is a pypdf artifact — the gazette footer is extracted in the middle of '本法相|關授權法規命令' across the page 4/5 break; I read both halves and the quote is correct as written.
